name: COLORE field algebra
description: The real-number field algebra from COLORE (the Common Logic Ontology Repository, M. Grüninger et al., University of Toronto): the ringoid tower field ⊃ commutative_ring ⊃ ring ⊃ semiring, with sum and prod axiomatised by associativity, commutativity, distributivity, identity and inverse. Imported through automatic cl-imports closure resolution (field → commutative_ring → ring → semiring) with the ring axioms' nested function terms relationalised on import — the first corpus UoD whose import chain was resolved by the machine, not by hand.
